answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake tokens that vest slowly, like a lotus rising through deep water: the stake is a costly signal that is cheap to verify but expensive to fake at scale. An attacker facing an ocean of cheap identities must lock real capital per identity for weeks, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught attesting fraudulently, so creating thousands of sock puppets costs thousands of stakes while honest agents keep one.
